prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE new opaque full-screen 2D mobile board-game city illustration, portrait 9:16 composition, target 1008 x 1792 pixels. It may look like a polished toy 3D diorama but is only a static 2D image. Fill the canvas edge-to-edge.
Primary request: newly draw a friendly New York coastal construction-city scene from a high oblique isometric camera. Keep this overall visual hierarchy: dense colorful miniature Manhattan-like buildings toward the upper-left background; a cute green Statue of Liberty landmark on a separate raised stone island in the upper-right/middle water; wide stepped waterfront streets, promenades and several broad buildable city platforms descending diagonally through the center-left toward the foreground; bright blue harbor water along the right. Do not paste, crop or reproduce a screenshot interface.
City composition: rows of warm peach, terracotta, cream and tan town buildings with varied heights, a few taller pale blue-gray towers behind them, occasional sea-green domed roofs. The foreground has generous gray-green city lots and simple paved coastal roads bordered by dark railings, small pedestrian crossings, a few tiny yellow taxis and sparse tiny pedestrians. Low stone or concrete quay walls make the land platforms clearly raised above the harbor. Populate edges with cute rounded ochre, orange and olive trees and small neighborhood buildings, without overcrowding the open construction lots. Harbor can have one or two tiny white boats, subtle white shore ripples, and blue/cyan water shading. The buildings, roads and shoreline continue into the upper and lower portions of the full image, including where a game's HUD or cards might later be overlaid.
Landmark: an original cute toy-like green Statue of Liberty with a simple friendly face, crown with restrained gold-bronze tips, upright torch, green robe and tablet. Place it prominently on a small square island/pedestal in the upper-right third. The statue is part of the world, not a UI icon or collectible card. No mascot top hat, moustache, logo or famous board-game character.
Palette and lighting: soft lavender/pink dusk sky and hazy distant green shore at the very top, warm peach/cream facades, muted green lots and trees, saturated medium-blue sea. Clear broad composition, clean low-poly shapes, soft warm daylight/dusk shading, readable toy-scale buildings, restrained texture, high quality finished mobile-game background.
Text: NONE anywhere. No signs with words, letters, labels, numbers, prices or currency glyphs.
Absolutely avoid: top HUD, bottom cards, card borders, text, counters, logo, banknote/coin/star UI, build buttons, menu buttons, checkmarks, progress indicators, close control, arrows, watermark, frame, phone bezel, black/transparent margins, cream interface panels. The top and bottom must be continuous city/harbor artwork, not blank areas or UI. No photorealistic city, no dramatic perspective lens, no actual 3D-engine output requirement.

visualInspection.subject: New York coastal miniature city with a cute green Statue of Liberty, stepped roads and building lots
visualInspection.palette: pink-lavender sky, warm peach buildings, green lots, blue harbor
visualInspection.hierarchy: dense upper-left city, upper-right island landmark, open center/foreground lots
